title: Associate Product Manager - Interns
jobDescription: We are looking for a highly motivated and enthusiastic Associate Product Manager to join our product engineering team focused on building AI-powered accelerator platforms, products, and enterprise solutions. This is an excellent opportunity for recent MBA graduates who are passionate about technology, Artificial Intelligence, and product management. As an Associate Product Manager, you will collaborate with engineering, product, marketing, and business stakeholders to define product strategy, understand customer needs, and contribute to the successful delivery of innovative AI solutions. Key Responsibilities Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to develop AI-powered platforms, products, and enterprise solutions. Support Product Leaders in defining the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and feature prioritization. Conduct customer research to understand business challenges, user needs, and pain points. Define product use cases, user stories, and acceptance criteria while maintaining and prioritizing the product backlog. Partner with engineering teams throughout the product development lifecycle to ensure successful feature delivery. Work closely with the marketing team to perform market research, competitive analysis, and product positioning. Monitor industry trends, emerging AI technologies, and customer feedback to identify new product opportunities. Assist in preparing product documentation, presentations, and go-to-market materials. Qualifications MBA (First Class) from a reputed Business School, completed in 2025 or later. Specialization in one or more of the following: IT Management Information Systems Management Technology Management Digital Transformation Business Analytics / Analytics Preferred Skills Strong interest in Product Management and Enterprise Technology. AI certifications, preferably in Generative AI. Good understanding of: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Agentic AI Model Context Protocol (MCP) Large Language Models (LLMs) AI Agents and Prompt Engineering Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies and product management practices. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, innovation-driven environment. Desired Attributes Self-motivated, energetic, and eager to learn. Strong customer-centric mindset. Passion for emerging technologies and AI-driven innovation. Ability to convert business requirements into product features. Excellent stakeholder management and teamwork skills. High level of ownership, curiosity, and initiative. title: Production Support Engineer
jobDescription: Role Summary We are looking for an Application Support Engineer with strong experience in supporting Java-based applications and integration middleware. The ideal candidate will have hands-on exposure to IBM MQ, Autosys job scheduling, enterprise monitoring tools (preferably Dynatrace), and solid Linux/Unix and SQL skills. Prior experience in banking or financial services is an added advantage. Key Responsibilities Provide L2/L3 support for business-critical Java applications in production and non-production environments. Monitor application health, performance, and availability using Dynatrace or similar APM/monitoring tools. Manage and troubleshoot IBM MQ messaging, including queues, channels, and message flows. Configure, schedule, and maintain Autosys jobs; analyze job failures and ensure timely resolution. Perform root cause analysis for incidents and problems; implement preventive measures and permanent fixes. Work with Linux/Unix systems to perform log analysis, process monitoring, deployment support, and environment checks. Write and optimize SQL queries for data analysis, troubleshooting, and reporting purposes. Collaborate with development, infrastructure, and business teams to ensure smooth application operations and changes. Create and maintain support documentation, runbooks, and standard operating procedures. Communicate effectively with stakeholders, providing clear status updates, incident reports, and technical explanations. Required Skills & Experience Java Application Support: Experience in supporting Java/J2EE applications in production environments. Good understanding of application logs, JVM parameters, and basic performance tuning concepts. IBM MQ: Hands-on experience with IBM MQ configuration and administration. Ability to debug messaging issues and monitor message queues and channels. Autosys Job Scheduling: Experience creating, modifying, and troubleshooting Autosys jobs. Understanding of job dependencies, calendars, and event handling. Monitoring Tools (Preferably Dynatrace): Experience using Dynatrace or similar APM tools (e.g., App Dynamics, New Relic). Ability to interpret dashboards, traces, and alerts to identify performance issues. Linux/Unix: Strong command-line skills (file operations, processes, network commands, shell basics). Experience with log analysis and basic scripting is a plus. SQL: Strong SQL querying skills (joins, aggregations, filters, performance considerations). Experience working with relational databases such as Oracle, My SQL, or Postgre SQL. Communication: Good written and verbal communication skills. Ability to interact with business users and technical teams in a clear and professional manner. Preferred Skills Domain Knowledge: Banking or financial services domain exposure (preferred but not mandatory). Familiarity with payments, core banking, or trading systems is an advantage. Additional Nice-to-Have: Experience with incident management tools (e.g., Service Now, JIRA). Knowledge of ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change Management). Basic scripting (Shell, Python, etc.) for automation of routine tasks. Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience). Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards, reports, and scorecards to support business reporting needs. Gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into effective data visualization solutions. Develop and optimize data models using Power BI, ensuring high performance and scalability. Collaborate with data engineers and database administrators to ensure data accuracy and integrity. Publish, manage, and maintain reports and datasets in the Power BI Service. Schedule data refreshes, manage workspaces, gateways, and deployment pipelines. Participate in code reviews, testing, documentation, and knowledge-sharing activities. Support production issues and enhance existing BI solutions based on business requirements. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in Business Intelligence or Data Analytics with strong expertise in Power BI. Hands-on experience in developing enterprise-level Power BI dashboards and reports. Strong proficiency in DAX, Power Query (M Language), and data modeling. Strong understanding of ETL concepts and data warehousing principles. Experience publishing and managing reports in Power BI Service. Knowledge of Power BI Gateway, workspace management, and scheduled refresh. Understanding of Row-Level Security (RLS), data governance, and report security. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with technical and business stakeholders. Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Microsoft Azure services such as Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, or Azure Data Lake. Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) or equivalent certification. Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric and modern analytics platforms. title: Manager - Talent Acquisition
jobDescription: Role Summary The Talent Acquisition Manager will lead end-to-end recruitment strategy and execution for the organization, with responsibility for senior and niche hiring across multiple business units. This role requires a seasoned HR professional (10+ years of experience) who can build strong stakeholder relationships, design scalable hiring processes, drive employer branding initiatives, and lead a high-performing TA team to meet aggressive hiring targets while maintaining quality and compliance. Key Responsibilities Strategic Talent Acquisition Develop and execute the overall talent acquisition strategy aligned with business growth plans. Partner with business leaders to understand workforce plans, role requirements, and future skill needs. Build and maintain a robust talent pipeline for critical, leadership, and niche positions. Use data and market insights to advise leadership on talent availability, compensation trends, and hiring risks. Recruitment Operations & Process Excellence Own the full recruitment lifecycle: sourcing, screening, interviewing, selection, offer management, and onboarding handoff. Design and continuously improve recruitment processes, SLAs, and governance to ensure efficiency and consistency. Implement and optimize use of ATS / recruitment tools, ensuring data accuracy and adherence to processes. Monitor key TA metrics (TAT, source mix, cost per hire, quality of hire, offer-to-join ratio) and drive improvements. Stakeholder Management Act as the primary TA partner for CXOs, business heads, and HRBPs on all hiring matters. Conduct regular reviews with stakeholders on hiring progress, challenges, and corrective actions. Influence and coach hiring managers on interviewing best practices, selection criteria, and market realities. Sourcing & Employer Branding Define multi-channel sourcing strategies (referrals, job portals, social media, networking, agencies, campus, etc.). Build and manage relationships with external recruitment partners and vendors. Collaborate with Marketing/HR to strengthen employer branding through campaigns, events, and digital presence. Represent the organization at industry events, job fairs, and campus engagements as needed. Team Leadership Lead, coach, and develop a team of recruiters and coordinators to deliver high-quality outcomes. Set clear performance goals and provide regular feedback, mentoring, and skills development opportunities. Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the TA team. Compliance & Governance Ensure all hiring practices comply with internal policies, local labour laws, and DEI guidelines. Drive fair, inclusive, and unbiased recruitment processes, including structured interviews and objective assessments. Maintain accurate and up-to-date recruitment documentation and reports for audits and management reviews. Required Qualifications & Experience 15+ years of progressive experience in Talent Acquisition / Recruitment, with at least 5+ years in a leadership/managerial role. Proven experience managing end-to-end recruitment for mid to large organizations (preferably IT/Consulting/Technology/Services – adjust as needed). Strong track record in leadership hiring, niche skill hiring, and building high-performing TA teams. Hands-on experience with ATS platforms, HRIS, and sourcing tools (Linked In, job boards, etc.). Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities. Skills & Competencies Strategic thinking & business acumen – ability to translate business needs into TA strategies. Stakeholder management & influencing skills – confident in dealing with senior leadership. Strong communication & negotiation skills – especially for senior-level offers and critical roles. Data-driven decision making – comfortable with metrics, dashboards, and recruitment analytics. People leadership – mentoring, coaching, and performance management of TA teams. Process orientation – able to design, document, and enforce recruitment processes. Market awareness – updated on talent market trends, competitors, and compensation benchmarks. Education Bachelor’s degree is mandatory; Master’s in HR/Business Administration (MBA/PGDM in HR) preferred. Success Measures / KPIs Time-to-fill and time-to-offer for key roles. title: Functional QA (Payments)
jobDescription: Functional Testers We are seeking an experienced Functional QA Engineer (Payments) to ensure the quality, reliability, and usability of our automation tools and software products. You will collaborate closely with Product Managers, Developers, and fellow QA Engineers to design, implement, and maintain effective test strategies and ensure a flawless user experience. Key Responsibilities Collaborate with Product Managers, Developers, and QA Engineers to understand product requirements and define comprehensive test strategies. Design, develop, and execute functional, regression, performance, and usability test cases. Identify, document, and track defects with clear steps to reproduce, including logs, screenshots, and other relevant details. Conduct functional testing across various modules and ensure thorough coverage of all user scenarios. Participate in usability testing, providing detailed feedback to improve the end-user experience. Support documentation teams by reviewing and validating user guides and troubleshooting materials. Maintain test data, environments, and update automation scripts to align with evolving tools and features. Continuously improve testing processes, tools, and metrics to enhance team efficiency and product quality. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth testing cycles and on-time delivery. Requirements 5+ years of experience in software testing, with strong focus on functional testing. Must have strong expertise in Payments domain. Proven ability to design and execute manual and automated test cases. Familiarity with test automation frameworks and scripting is a plus. Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, and quality assurance best practices. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills. Strong communication and documentation abilities, capable of working effectively across teams. Experience in performance or usability testing is an advantage. title: AI Developer
jobDescription: Role Summary We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Developer with around 5 years of industry experience to design, develop, and deploy machine learning and AI solutions for enterprise-grade applications. The ideal candidate will have strong foundations in ML/DL, solid programming skills, and experience taking models from experimentation to production. Key Responsibilities Solution Design & Development Design, implement, and optimize machine learning, deep learning, and AI-based solutions for real-world business problems. Translate functional requirements into scalable ML architectures and pipelines. Build, evaluate, and iterate on models using appropriate algorithms and frameworks. Model Lifecycle Management Perform end-to-end model development: data exploration, feature engineering, model training, validation, and tuning. Implement MLOps best practices for model versioning, deployment, monitoring, and retraining. Collaborate with Dev Ops/Cloud teams to deploy models to production (batch, real-time, or streaming). Data Engineering & Pipelines Work closely with data engineers to design robust data pipelines and ETL processes. Ensure data quality, consistency, and governance practices are followed. Handle large datasets and optimize data processing performance. Collaboration & Stakeholder Management Work with product owners, business stakeholders, and architects to understand requirements and define AI/ML roadmaps. Present insights, model performance, and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Mentor junior developers and contribute to knowledge sharing within the AI/ML team. Quality, Security & Compliance Ensure AI solutions adhere to organizational standards for security, privacy, and compliance. Implement unit tests, integration tests, and code reviews for ML components. Maintain comprehensive technical documentation and best practices. Required Skills & Qualifications Education Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or related field (or equivalent industry experience). Technical Skills Strong programming skills in Python (preferred) and familiarity with one or more: Java, Scala, R. Hands-on experience with ML/DL frameworks: scikit-learn, Tensor Flow, Keras, Py Torch (at least one in depth). Experience with data manipulation and analysis using Pandas, Num Py, SQL. Solid understanding of supervised, unsupervised, and deep learning techniques (classification, regression, clustering, NLP, computer vision, etc.). Experience building and consuming REST APIs or microservices for AI/ML features. Familiarity with MLOps tools and workflows (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring tools). Experience with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) and related AI/ML services. Working knowledge of Git and standard software engineering practices (code review, branching, CI/CD). Conceptual Knowledge Strong grasp of statistics, probability, and linear algebra relevant to ML. Understanding of model explainability, fairness, and ethical AI considerations. Knowledge of performance optimization techniques: hyperparameter tuning, model compression, etc. Soft Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail. Ability to work in an agile environment and handle multiple tasks/projects. Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written. Collaborative mindset and willingness to mentor others. Preferred / Nice-to-Have Experience with NLP (transformers, LLMs) or computer vision (CNNs, image processing). Exposure to big data technologies (Spark, Hadoop, Kafka). Experience integrating AI/ML solutions into enterprise applications (e.g., ERP, CRM, custom platforms). Background in domain-specific AI (e.g., BFSI, healthcare, manufacturing, retail). Contributions to open-source projects or publications in AI/ML. Strong experience with Microsoft SQL Server and advanced SQL query development. Experience with messaging technologies, particularly Solace Queue. Ability to interpret technical documentation and translate requirements into code. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Ability to work independently and within Agile development teams. Experience with monitoring, logging, and performance optimization tools. Experience 3+ years of backend development experience using Java and/or Golang. Experience developing enterprise-grade applications and scalable distributed systems. title: Test Manager
jobDescription: Position Summary We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Test Manager to lead Quality Assurance initiatives across enterprise application portfolios. The ideal candidate will have 12+ years of QA experience, including 5+ years in Test Management or QA Leadership, with a proven ability to lead high-performing manual and automation testing teams. This role requires strong expertise in test strategy, quality governance, automation, stakeholder management, and Agile delivery to ensure the successful execution of complex, business-critical projects. Key Responsibilities Test Strategy & Quality Leadership Define and implement enterprise-wide test strategies, quality standards, and testing best practices across multiple projects. Lead end-to-end testing activities throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), ensuring comprehensive test coverage and high-quality deliverables. Establish quality gates, testing processes, and governance frameworks aligned with organizational objectives. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance testing efficiency, automation adoption, and overall product quality. Test Planning & Execution Develop comprehensive test plans, test schedules, resource plans, and testing estimates for large-scale projects. Oversee functional, integration, system, regression, user acceptance, API, mobile, web, and performance testing activities. Ensure effective test environment readiness, test data management, and release validation. Monitor testing progress, identify risks, and implement mitigation plans to ensure timely project delivery. Automation & Continuous Testing Lead automation strategy and implementation across multiple technology stacks. Guide teams in developing and maintaining scalable automation frameworks using industry-standard tools and technologies. Promote shift-left testing practices and integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. Collaborate with development and Dev Ops teams to improve deployment quality and release efficiency. Defect & Quality Management Manage the complete defect lifecycle, including defect triage, prioritization, tracking, reporting, and closure. Conduct root cause analysis for production defects and recommend preventive actions. Define and monitor quality metrics, KPIs, dashboards, and reporting to provide visibility into testing effectiveness and product quality. Ensure compliance with organizational quality standards and delivery processes. Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management Lead and mentor cross-functional teams comprising manual and automation QA engineers. Provide technical guidance, coaching, and career development support to team members. Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Development, Dev Ops, and Project Management teams to ensure alignment with business objectives. Communicate project status, quality metrics, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership and stakeholders. Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, and continuous learning. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. 12+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance. 5+ years of experience in Test Management, QA Leadership, or equivalent leadership roles. Proven experience leading blended manual and automation testing teams for large-scale enterprise projects. Strong understanding of Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), Software Testing Lifecycle (STLC), Agile, Scrum, and Dev Ops methodologies. Demonstrated experience managing complex testing programs across multiple applications and technology platforms. Excellent analytical, leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Technical Skills Testing Expertise Functional Testing Integration Testing System Testing Regression Testing User Acceptance Testing (UAT) API Testing Web Application Testing Mobile Application Testing Performance Testing End-to-End Testing Automation Selenium Playwright Cypress Appium Tricentis Tosca Rest Assured Java (Automation Development) Other equivalent automation frameworks Dev Ops & CI/CD Jenkins Git Hub Actions CI/CD Pipeline Integration Shift-Left Testing Test Environment Management Test Data Management Quality Management Test Strategy & Planning Defect Lifecycle Management Root Cause Analysis Test Metrics & Reporting Risk Management Quality Governance Preferred Qualifications Experience working in enterprise-scale digital transformation programs. Exposure to cloud-based applications and modern application architectures. Experience implementing enterprise test automation strategies. Knowledge of performance engineering and non-functional testing best practices. Professional certifications such as ISTQB Advanced, Certified Agile Tester, or equivalent are desirable. Key Competencies Strategic quality leadership Test planning and execution excellence Automation and continuous testing expertise Strong project and stakeholder management Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities Effective team leadership and mentoring Outstanding communication and presentation skills Risk identification and mitigation Continuous improvement mindset Ability to deliver high-quality solutions within aggressive timelines while aligning testing outcomes with business goals. jobDescription: Job Summary We are seeking a skilled and experienced Power BI Developer with 5+ years of expertise in designing, developing, and maintaining interactive business intelligence solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in Power BI, data modeling, DAX, SQL, and ETL processes, with the ability to transform complex data into meaningful insights that support strategic business decisions. You will work closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, and cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and high-quality reporting solutions. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards, reports, and scorecards to support business reporting needs. Gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into effective data visualization solutions. Develop and optimize data models using Power BI, ensuring high performance and scalability. Create complex DAX measures, calculated columns, and KPIs to deliver meaningful business insights. Develop and optimize Power Query (M Language) transformations for efficient data preparation. Connect Power BI to multiple data sources, including SQL Server, Azure, Excel, APIs, and cloud-based platforms. Design and implement ETL processes for data extraction, transformation, and loading. Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize report performance and refresh schedules. Implement Row-Level Security (RLS), data governance, and security best practices. Collaborate with data engineers and database administrators to ensure data accuracy and integrity. Publish, manage, and maintain reports and datasets in the Power BI Service. Schedule data refreshes, manage workspaces, gateways, and deployment pipelines. Participate in code reviews, testing, documentation, and knowledge-sharing activities. Support production issues and enhance existing BI solutions based on business requirements. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in Business Intelligence or Data Analytics with strong expertise in Power BI. Hands-on experience in developing enterprise-level Power BI dashboards and reports. Strong proficiency in DAX, Power Query (M Language), and data modeling. Advanced SQL skills with experience in writing complex queries, stored procedures, and performance optimization. Experience working with SQL Server and other relational databases. Strong understanding of ETL concepts and data warehousing principles. Experience publishing and managing reports in Power BI Service. Knowledge of Power BI Gateway, workspace management, and scheduled refresh. Understanding of Row-Level Security (RLS), data governance, and report security. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with technical and business stakeholders. Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Microsoft Azure services such as Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, or Azure Data Lake. Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) or equivalent certification. Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric and modern analytics platforms. Experience with Python or R for advanced analytics and data visualization. Familiarity with SSIS, SSRS, SSAS, or other Microsoft BI technologies. title: .Net Developer
jobDescription: Position Summary We are seeking a skilled and motivated .NET Developer with experience in C#.NET, Microsoft technologies, and Databricks to design, develop, maintain, and support enterprise applications. The ideal candidate will contribute to the full software development lifecycle while also providing production support for business-critical applications. Experience with Azure, SQL Server, CI/CD, and cloud-native technologies will be an added advantage. Key Responsibilities Application Development Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain enterprise applications using C#.NET, .NET Framework/.NET Core, and related Microsoft technologies. Build scalable, secure, and high-performance applications following coding standards and best practices. Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and web services. Work with Databricks to build and maintain data engineering, analytics, and ETL workflows. Develop and optimize database objects including tables, stored procedures, views, and queries in SQL Server. Participate in application architecture discussions, code reviews, sprint planning, and Agile ceremonies. Collaborate with Business Analysts, QA, Dev Ops, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality software solutions. Prepare technical documentation, design specifications, and deployment documentation. Production Support Provide L2/L3 production support for enterprise applications. Investigate production incidents, perform root cause analysis, and implement timely resolutions. Execute hotfixes, emergency deployments, and production patches while adhering to change management processes. Monitor application health and proactively identify opportunities for performance improvement. Document known issues, troubleshooting procedures, and resolution steps in the knowledge repository. Participate in on-call support rotations and provide after-hours support when required. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. Strong experience in C#.NET, ASP.NET, and Microsoft technology stack. Experience developing and consuming RESTful APIs and web services. Hands-on experience with SQL Server, including database design, stored procedures, query optimization, and performance tuning. Experience working with Databricks for data processing and analytics workloads. Solid understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile methodologies. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and collaboration abilities. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Microsoft Azure services such as Azure App Services, Azure Functions, and Azure SQL. Hands-on experience with Databricks Workflows, Delta Lake, Py Spark, or Spark SQL. Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment practices. Experience with microservices architecture and containerization technologies such as Docker. Experience in banking, financial services, or other regulated industries. title: Test Manager
jobDescription: Position Summary We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Test Manager to lead Quality Assurance initiatives across enterprise application portfolios. The ideal candidate will have 12+ years of QA experience, including 5+ years in Test Management or QA Leadership, with a proven ability to lead high-performing manual and automation testing teams. This role requires strong expertise in test strategy, quality governance, automation, stakeholder management, and Agile delivery to ensure the successful execution of complex, business-critical projects. Key Responsibilities Test Strategy & Quality Leadership Define and implement enterprise-wide test strategies, quality standards, and testing best practices across multiple projects. Lead end-to-end testing activities throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), ensuring comprehensive test coverage and high-quality deliverables. Establish quality gates, testing processes, and governance frameworks aligned with organizational objectives. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance testing efficiency, automation adoption, and overall product quality. Test Planning & Execution Develop comprehensive test plans, test schedules, resource plans, and testing estimates for large-scale projects. Oversee functional, integration, system, regression, user acceptance, API, mobile, web, and performance testing activities. Ensure effective test environment readiness, test data management, and release validation. Monitor testing progress, identify risks, and implement mitigation plans to ensure timely project delivery. Automation & Continuous Testing Lead automation strategy and implementation across multiple technology stacks. Guide teams in developing and maintaining scalable automation frameworks using industry-standard tools and technologies. Promote shift-left testing practices and integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. Collaborate with development and Dev Ops teams to improve deployment quality and release efficiency. Defect & Quality Management Manage the complete defect lifecycle, including defect triage, prioritization, tracking, reporting, and closure. Conduct root cause analysis for production defects and recommend preventive actions. Define and monitor quality metrics, KPIs, dashboards, and reporting to provide visibility into testing effectiveness and product quality. Ensure compliance with organizational quality standards and delivery processes. Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management Lead and mentor cross-functional teams comprising manual and automation QA engineers. Provide technical guidance, coaching, and career development support to team members. Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Development, Dev Ops, and Project Management teams to ensure alignment with business objectives. Communicate project status, quality metrics, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership and stakeholders. Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, and continuous learning. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. 12+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance. 5+ years of experience in Test Management, QA Leadership, or equivalent leadership roles. Proven experience leading blended manual and automation testing teams for large-scale enterprise projects. Strong understanding of Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), Software Testing Lifecycle (STLC), Agile, Scrum, and Dev Ops methodologies. Demonstrated experience managing complex testing programs across multiple applications and technology platforms. Excellent analytical, leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Technical Skills Testing Expertise Functional Testing Integration Testing System Testing Regression Testing User Acceptance Testing (UAT) API Testing Web Application Testing Mobile Application Testing Performance Testing End-to-End Testing Automation Selenium Playwright Cypress Appium Tricentis Tosca Rest Assured Java (Automation Development) Other equivalent automation frameworks Dev Ops & CI/CD Jenkins Git Hub Actions CI/CD Pipeline Integration Shift-Left Testing Test Environment Management Test Data Management Quality Management Test Strategy & Planning Defect Lifecycle Management Root Cause Analysis Test Metrics & Reporting Risk Management Quality Governance Preferred Qualifications Experience working in enterprise-scale digital transformation programs. Exposure to cloud-based applications and modern application architectures. Experience implementing enterprise test automation strategies. Knowledge of performance engineering and non-functional testing best practices. Professional certifications such as ISTQB Advanced, Certified Agile Tester, or equivalent are desirable. Key Competencies Strategic quality leadership Test planning and execution excellence Automation and continuous testing expertise Strong project and stakeholder management Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities Effective team leadership and mentoring Outstanding communication and presentation skills Risk identification and mitigation Continuous improvement mindset Ability to deliver high-quality solutions within aggressive timelines while aligning testing outcomes with business goals. title: PCO / PMO Analyst
jobDescription: Position Summary We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive PMO Analyst to support project governance, financial operations, and portfolio management activities across multiple initiatives. The successful candidate will play a key role in maintaining project data integrity, supporting financial reconciliation, preparing management reports, and ensuring compliance with PMO standards and governance processes. This role requires strong analytical skills, excellent communication, and the ability to collaborate effectively with global stakeholders across multiple time zones. Key Responsibilities Project Management Office (PMO) Support Support day-to-day PMO operations by maintaining project governance standards, documentation, and reporting. Monitor project schedules, milestones, risks, issues, and dependencies to ensure timely delivery. Maintain project records, status reports, dashboards, and portfolio documentation. Assist Project Managers in tracking project progress and ensuring adherence to organizational PMO processes. Coordinate governance meetings, prepare meeting materials, document action items, and follow up on deliverables. Financial Management & Reporting Support project financial tracking, budgeting, forecasting, and reconciliation activities. Validate project costs, resource allocations, and financial data to ensure accuracy. Assist in monthly financial reporting, variance analysis, and portfolio reporting. Coordinate with finance and project teams to resolve financial discrepancies and maintain data consistency. Ensure compliance with financial governance policies and reporting requirements. Portfolio & Data Management Maintain accurate project and portfolio information within project management systems. Generate and analyze project performance metrics, dashboards, and executive reports. Support data quality initiatives by validating project information and ensuring reporting accuracy. Assist in preparing portfolio presentations and management reports for leadership reviews. Stakeholder Coordination Collaborate with Project Managers, PMO leadership, Finance, Business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams. Support communication across geographically distributed teams and multiple time zones. Assist in coordinating project governance activities, reviews, and status reporting. Contribute to process improvement initiatives that enhance PMO efficiency and reporting quality. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Project Management, or a related discipline. 2–5 years of experience in a Project Management Office (PMO), project coordination, project administration, or financial operations role. Experience supporting project governance, reporting, financial tracking, and portfolio management activities. Strong analytical and organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Ability to manage multiple priorities while working independently and collaboratively. Technical Skills Hands-on experience with project management tools such as Planview and/or JIRA. Familiarity with financial systems; experience with Eclipse is considered an advantage. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data analysis, reporting, and financial tracking. Experience developing dashboards and reports using Microsoft Power BI. Strong working knowledge of the Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Power Point, Outlook, Excel). Core Competencies Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities. Effective written and verbal communication skills. Strong organizational and time management capabilities. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. Collaborative mindset with experience working across global teams and multiple time zones. Understanding of PMO governance frameworks, project lifecycle management, and financial reconciliation processes. Ability to maintain confidentiality and manage sensitive project information. title: .Net Fullstack Developer
jobDescription: Position Summary We are seeking a highly motivated .NET Full Stack Developer with 4–6 years of professional software development experience to design, build, and enhance Azure-hosted applications supporting Global Asset Management solutions. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise across the Microsoft technology stack, modern frontend frameworks, cloud-native development, and Dev Ops practices. This role offers the opportunity to work closely with product owners, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to deliver secure, scalable, and high-quality enterprise applications. Key Responsibilities Application Development Design, develop, test, and maintain enterprise-grade applications using C#, .NET Core/.NET 6+, and Microsoft technologies. Develop scalable and secure RESTful APIs and implement microservice-based solutions where appropriate. Build responsive, user-friendly web applications using Angular or React with Type Script. Design and optimize relational database schemas, develop SQL queries, stored procedures, and ensure database performance. Develop Azure-hosted solutions leveraging Azure Functions, App Services, and Azure SQL. Implement secure authentication and authorization using OAuth 2.0, Open ID Connect (OIDC), and Azure Entra ID. Participate in architecture discussions, technical design reviews, and code reviews to ensure solution quality and maintainability. Produce clean, reusable, well-documented code that adheres to enterprise development standards and best practices. Cloud & Dev Ops Build, deploy, and maintain cloud-native applications using Microsoft Azure services. Develop and support CI/CD pipelines using Azure Dev Ops or Git Hub Enterprise. Collaborate with Dev Ops teams to automate application deployments and improve release processes. Monitor application performance and proactively address reliability, scalability, and security concerns. Quality Assurance Develop comprehensive unit and integration tests using frameworks such as x Unit, NUnit, Jest, or Jasmine. Participate in peer code reviews, static code analysis, and quality assurance activities. Troubleshoot application issues and implement performance improvements and bug fixes. Maintain technical documentation, API specifications, and deployment documentation. Agile Delivery & Collaboration Participate actively in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, QA engineers, UX designers, and business stakeholders. Mentor junior developers by providing technical guidance, knowledge sharing, and code review feedback. Communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Generative AI Adoption Utilize Git Hub Copilot, Chat GPT, and other approved AI-assisted development tools to improve development productivity. Create structured prompts for code generation, unit testing, documentation, debugging, and refactoring. Review, validate, and refine AI-generated code to ensure security, maintainability, and compliance with organizational coding standards. Promote responsible adoption of AI-assisted software development practices within the engineering team. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. 4–6 years of professional experience in full-stack software development. title: DevOps Engineer
jobDescription: What You’ll Be Doing You’ll be joining CIBC’s Capital Markets Technology group within the US Cash Management- Global Transactions team. As a Sr. Consultant, Dev Ops, you will leverage deep expertise in Dev Ops practices, automation, and cloud technologies to drive transformation, streamline processes, and enable continuous delivery of high-quality solutions. This role involves close collaboration with cross-functional teams, providing strategic guidance, hands-on implementation, and mentorship to accelerate our Dev Ops maturity. At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You’ll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you’ll spend 2 days per week on-site, while other days will be remote. How You’ll Succeed Dev Ops Strategy & Implementation: Develop and execute Dev Ops strategies aligned with organizational objectives; design and implement CI/CD pipelines, automation frameworks, and infrastructure as code. Cloud & Automation: Architect, deploy, and manage scalable cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) using automation tools such as Terraform and Ansible Monitoring & Optimization: Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions; proactively identify and resolve system bottlenecks, security vulnerabilities, and performance issues. Process Improvement: Analyze existing workflows, identify opportunities for process automation and optimization, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. Security & Compliance: Ensure solutions comply with organizational policies and industry regulations; integrate security best practices into Dev Ops pipelines. Who You Are You can demonstrate experience with: at least 7 years of Dev Ops experience. Including strong technical trouble-shooting ability with knowledge of approaches, tools and techniques for anticipating, recognizing, and resolving technical (software, application or operational) problems and interpreting server logs. Supporting Infrastructure requests, Dev/SIT environments and building pipelines. Strong Asset if you have experience with Microsoft Co-Pilot and/or Git Hub Actions. You're digitally savvy. You seek out innovative solutions and embrace evolving technologies. You can easily adapt to new tools and trends. You put our clients first. You engage with purpose and the required level of urgency to find the right solutions. You go the extra mile, because it’s the right thing to do. You understand that success is in the details. You notice things that others don't. Your critical thinking skills help to inform your decision making. Your influence makes an impact. You know that relationships and networks are essential to success. You inspire outcomes by making yourself heard. Values matter to you. You bring your real self to work and you live our values – trust, teamwork and accountability. What you need to know CIBC is committed to creating an inclusive environment where all team members and clients feel like they belong. title: Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineer
jobDescription: Role Summary We are looking for an experienced Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Azure, Kubernetes, and Red Hat Open Shift, combined with solid application development and Dev Ops skills. The role involves designing and managing scalable cloud platforms, implementing Infrastructure as Code, optimizing performance, and building advanced simulators and test environments to support enterprise-grade applications. Key Responsibilities Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Management Design, deploy, and manage Azure cloud infrastructure including: Virtual Networks (VNets), subnets, and connectivity Compute resources (VMs, AKS, scale sets) Storage solutions (Blob, Disk, Files) Security services (Key Vault, Azure AD integration, policies) Architect, implement, and maintain Red Hat Open Shift container platforms for enterprise application deployment. Implement Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) using tools such as Terraform for repeatable, auditable environment provisioning. Manage Kubernetes clusters (Azure Kubernetes Service / Open Shift) and orchestrate containerized applications across multiple environments. Performance & Optimization Plan and conduct comprehensive performance testing using tools like JMeter and Neoload. Analyze application and infrastructure performance metrics to identify bottlenecks and resource constraints. Implement performance tuning strategies for cloud resources, container platforms, and applications. Define and maintain performance benchmarks, SLAs, and SLOs for critical systems and services. Networking & Security Design and implement Azure networking solutions including: VNets, subnets, peering, and VPN/Express Route Network Security Groups (NSGs), firewalls, and routing Application Gateways, Load Balancers, and ingress solutions Configure and manage Open Shift networking components such as SDN, ingress controllers, and network policies. Implement and enforce security best practices for cloud and container environments, including identity, access management, and compliance controls. Troubleshoot complex networking issues across hybrid and multi-cloud environments, collaborating with infrastructure and security teams. Application Development & Dev Ops Develop and maintain cloud-native applications using modern programming languages (e.g., Python, Go, Java, C#, or similar). Design and develop simulators for testing, training, and validation purposes, supporting various system and integration scenarios. Build mock services and virtual environments to simulate real-world systems, third-party integrations, and external APIs. Design and implement CI/CD pipelines for automated application deployment using Git Hub Actions (and other Dev Ops tools as needed). Collaborate with development teams to optimize application architecture for cloud platforms, ensuring scalability, resilience, and cost efficiency. Create automation scripts (e.g., Power Shell, Bash, Python) for infrastructure management and deployment workflows. Build realistic simulators to replicate production environments, external dependencies, and failure scenarios. Develop test harnesses and simulation frameworks to support load testing, resilience testing, and chaos engineering. Build training and sandbox environments for development, QA, and experimentation. Design data-driven simulators with configurable scenarios and behaviors to support complex business and operational use cases. Required Skills & Experience Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud services (networking, compute, storage, security). Experience architecting and administering Red Hat Open Shift or other enterprise Kubernetes platforms. Practical experience implementing Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) using Terraform (or similar tools). Solid understanding and operational experience with Kubernetes, containers (Docker), and microservices. Proven experience in performance testing using JMeter, Neoload, or equivalent tools. Strong grasp of cloud networking concepts, security controls, and hybrid connectivity solutions. Experience developing cloud-native applications using at least one modern programming language. Hands-on experience building CI/CD pipelines (preferably with Git Hub Actions) and integrating with cloud platforms. Experience creating simulators, mock services, and complex test environments for application and integration testing. Good understanding of Dev Ops practices, automation, and observability tools (logging, metrics, tracing). Soft Skills Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to tackle complex technical issues across infrastructure, networking, and applications. Clear verbal and written communication skills, able to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams (development, QA, operations, security, and business stakeholders). Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Proactive attitude, willingness to learn new technologies, and ownership mindset for assigned tasks and deliverables. High attention to detail and strong commitment to quality, reliability, and operational excellence. Education Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience). Relevant certifications in Azure, Kubernetes, Open Shift, or Dev Ops will be an added advantage. description: Role Summary We are looking for an experienced Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Azure, Kubernetes, and Red Hat Open Shift, combined with solid application development and Dev Ops skills. The role involves designing and managing scalable cloud platforms, implementing Infrastructure as Code, optimizing performance, and building advanced simulators and test environments to support enterprise-grade applications. Key Responsibilities Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Management Design, deploy, and manage Azure cloud infrastructure including: Virtual Networks (VNets), subnets, and connectivity Compute resources (VMs, AKS, scale sets) Storage solutions (Blob, Disk, Files) Security services (Key Vault, Azure AD integration, policies) Architect, implement, and maintain Red Hat Open Shift container platforms for enterprise application deployment. Implement Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) using tools such as Terraform for repeatable, auditable environment provisioning. Manage Kubernetes clusters (Azure Kubernetes Service / Open Shift) and orchestrate containerized applications across multiple environments. Performance & Optimization Plan and conduct comprehensive performance testing using tools like JMeter and Neoload. Analyze application and infrastructure performance metrics to identify bottlenecks and resource constraints. Implement performance tuning strategies for cloud resources, container platforms, and applications. Define and maintain performance benchmarks, SLAs, and SLOs for critical systems and services. Networking & Security Design and implement Azure networking solutions including: VNets, subnets, peering, and VPN/Express Route Network Security Groups (NSGs), firewalls, and routing Application Gateways, Load Balancers, and ingress solutions Configure and manage Open Shift networking components such as SDN, ingress controllers, and network policies. Implement and enforce security best practices for cloud and container environments, including identity, access management, and compliance controls. Troubleshoot complex networking issues across hybrid and multi-cloud environments, collaborating with infrastructure and security teams. Application Development & Dev Ops Develop and maintain cloud-native applications using modern programming languages (e.g., Python, Go, Java, C#, or similar). Design and develop simulators for testing, training, and validation purposes, supporting various system and integration scenarios. Build mock services and virtual environments to simulate real-world systems, third-party integrations, and external APIs. Design and implement CI/CD pipelines for automated application deployment using Git Hub Actions (and other Dev Ops tools as needed). Collaborate with development teams to optimize application architecture for cloud platforms, ensuring scalability, resilience, and cost efficiency. Create automation scripts (e.g., Power Shell, Bash, Python) for infrastructure management and deployment workflows. Build realistic simulators to replicate production environments, external dependencies, and failure scenarios. Develop test harnesses and simulation frameworks to support load testing, resilience testing, and chaos engineering. Build training and sandbox environments for development, QA, and experimentation. Design data-driven simulators with configurable scenarios and behaviors to support complex business and operational use cases. Required Skills & Experience Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud services (networking, compute, storage, security). Experience architecting and administering Red Hat Open Shift or other enterprise Kubernetes platforms. Practical experience implementing Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) using Terraform (or similar tools). Solid understanding and operational experience with Kubernetes, containers (Docker), and microservices. Proven experience in performance testing using JMeter, Neoload, or equivalent tools. Strong grasp of cloud networking concepts, security controls, and hybrid connectivity solutions. Experience developing cloud-native applications using at least one modern programming language. Hands-on experience building CI/CD pipelines (preferably with Git Hub Actions) and integrating with cloud platforms. Experience creating simulators, mock services, and complex test environments for application and integration testing. Good understanding of Dev Ops practices, automation, and observability tools (logging, metrics, tracing). Soft Skills Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to tackle complex technical issues across infrastructure, networking, and applications. Clear verbal and written communication skills, able to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams (development, QA, operations, security, and business stakeholders). Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Proactive attitude, willingness to learn new technologies, and ownership mindset for assigned tasks and deliverables. High attention to detail and strong commitment to quality, reliability, and operational excellence. Education Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience). Relevant certifications in Azure, Kubernetes, Open Shift, or Dev Ops will be an added advantage. title: Subject Matter Expert
jobDescription: Position Summary We are seeking an experienced Trade360 Solution Lead / Subject Matter Expert (SME) to lead the successful delivery of Trade360 implementation and enhancement projects. The ideal candidate will serve as the functional and technical authority for the Trade360 platform, driving end-to-end solution design, stakeholder collaboration, release management, and production readiness. This role requires strong expertise in trade finance processes, system integrations, data transformation, and cross-functional leadership to ensure successful project execution from initiation through post-production support. Key Responsibilities Trade360 Solution Leadership Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the Trade360 platform across multiple implementation, enhancement, and support initiatives. Provide end-to-end solution leadership by defining application architecture, functional design, system interfaces, and integration approaches. Offer authoritative guidance on Trade360 capabilities, configuration, data flows, and best practices to project teams and business stakeholders. Ensure solution designs align with business requirements, regulatory standards, and enterprise architecture guidelines. Solution Design & Integration Lead solution design workshops and collaborate with business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions. Define, review, and validate system interfaces, integration specifications, and data transformation rules. Ensure seamless integration between Trade360 and upstream/downstream enterprise applications. Facilitate data conversion and migration activities, ensuring compliance with industry standards such as SWIFT and internal governance requirements. Project & Stakeholder Management Coordinate cross-functional teams including Business, Business Analysts, Quality Assurance, Network, Infrastructure, Vendors, and Operations to ensure successful project delivery. Manage project dependencies, risks, issues, and action items while maintaining delivery timelines and budget objectives. Act as the primary liaison between internal stakeholders and external vendors throughout the project lifecycle. Drive effective communication across technical and business teams to ensure alignment and timely decision-making. Release & Change Management Lead end-to-end release planning and change management activities across the project lifecycle. Validate implementation scope, perform impact assessments, and coordinate deployment planning. Manage stakeholder communications before, during, and after production releases. Oversee production deployment activities and coordinate post-release validation and stabilization. Drive continuous improvement of release management processes and implementation practices. Quality Assurance & Testing Review and support QA strategies, test plans, and end-to-end business test scenarios. Validate test coverage, test data preparation, and functional readiness for production deployment. Facilitate business demonstrations, user acceptance testing (UAT), test result reviews, and release readiness sessions. Ensure defects and issues are tracked, prioritized, and resolved within agreed timelines. Production Readiness & Support Oversee pre-implementation readiness activities, including administrative configurations, environment preparation, production implementation verification (PIV), and deployment checklists. Lead post-production issue management through structured incident and problem management processes. Coordinate root cause analysis, issue resolution, and stakeholder communication until successful closure. Ensure documentation, knowledge transfer, and operational readiness are completed for production support teams. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline. Extensive experience implementing and supporting the Trade360 platform. Strong understanding of trade finance operations, banking workflows, and financial messaging standards. Experience leading end-to-end solution design, system integration, and enterprise application implementations. Strong knowledge of data migration, data transformation, and interface design. Experience managing cross-functional teams and coordinating multiple stakeholders. Proven expertise in release management, change management, and production deployments. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience within banking, trade finance, or financial services organizations. Knowledge of SWIFT messaging standards, payment processing, and trade finance products. Experience working within Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies. Familiarity with enterprise integration platforms, middleware technologies, and API-based integrations. Additional Desired Attributes · Experience in banking or financial services environments. · Proactive approach to learning and adapting to new technologies. title: General Manager - HR
jobDescription:
Role Summary The General Manager – Talent Acquisition is a senior leadership role responsible for designing and driving the organization’s overall talent acquisition strategy across all business units and geographies. With 20+ years of experience, this role oversees leadership hiring, large-scale ramp-ups, global workforce planning, employer branding, and TA transformation initiatives. The GM-TA partners closely with CXO-level stakeholders to ensure the organization attracts, hires, and retains high-quality talent aligned with current and future business needs. Key Responsibilities
1. Talent Acquisition Strategy & Workforce Planning Define and own the long-term talent acquisition strategy aligned to business and growth plans. Partner with CXOs, Business Heads, and HR leadership to forecast manpower needs and critical skill requirements. Develop annual and quarterly hiring plans including budgets, resource allocation, and vendor strategy. Drive strategic initiatives such as succession pipelines, leadership hiring programs, and niche skill acquisition.
2. TA Governance, Policy & Process Excellence Establish and govern TA policies, frameworks, and SOPs across all business units and locations. Standardize recruitment processes, SLAs, and governance models to ensure consistency and scalability. Ensure effective use and optimization of ATS, HRIS, and analytics tools; drive automation and digitization in TA. Monitor and improve core TA metrics (time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, quality-of-hire, offer-to-join, diversity ratios, etc.).
3. Leadership & Critical Hiring Lead end-to-end hiring for senior leadership and business-critical roles. Act as a strategic advisor for CXOs on talent market trends, compensation benchmarks, and candidate engagement. Oversee robust assessment frameworks (competency-based interviews, psychometric tools, case studies, etc.) for senior roles. Ensure confidentiality and high-touch candidate experience for executive-level hiring.
4. Employer Branding & Talent Market Positioning Define and drive the employer branding strategy to position the organization as an employer of choice. Collaborate with Marketing/Corporate Communications on digital campaigns, social media presence, and brand assets. Represent the organization at industry forums, conferences, campus events, and networking platforms. Build long-term relationships with universities, professional bodies, and talent communities.
5. TA Organization & People Leadership Lead and manage the entire TA function, including regional / BU TA Heads, recruiters, and coordinators. Design TA org structure, roles, capacity planning, and career paths within the function. Provide coaching, mentorship, and leadership development for TA team members and high-potential recruiters. Foster a culture of performance, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement in the TA function.
6. Vendor, Partner & Stakeholder Management Develop and manage strategic partnerships with recruitment agencies, search firms, RPOs, and other vendors. Negotiate commercial terms, SLAs, and performance metrics with external partners. Conduct regular reviews with business stakeholders on hiring progress, challenges, and corrective actions. Influence and coach senior stakeholders on talent strategies, interview effectiveness, and market realities.
7. Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI) in Hiring Integrate DEI principles into all hiring strategies and processes. Set diversity hiring goals in collaboration with HR and business leadership. Drive initiatives to improve representation across levels and functions (gender, geography, background, etc.). Ensure unbiased selection practices through structured interviews and objective assessment tools.
8. Compliance, Risk & Audit Ensure recruitment practices comply with company policies, labour laws, and regulatory requirements across regions. Maintain robust documentation, audit trails, and reporting mechanisms for internal and external audits. Mitigate hiring-related risks (fraud prevention, data privacy, conflict of interest, etc.). Align TA governance with broader HR governance, ethics, and compliance frameworks.
9. Analytics, Insights & Continuous Improvement Build and maintain TA dashboards and reporting for leadership reviews. Use data analytics to identify bottlenecks, forecast hiring risks, and recommend corrective actions. Benchmark TA performance against industry standards and competitors. Champion continuous improvement projects (process re-engineering, technology upgrades, sourcing innovations). Required Qualifications & Experience 20+ years of progressive experience in Talent Acquisition / Recruitment, with at least 8–10 years in senior leadership roles (Head TA / GM / Director level). Proven experience leading large-scale hiring for mid-to-large organizations (preferably IT/ITES, Consulting, Technology, BFSI, or similar – customize as needed). Strong track record in leadership hiring, global/niche skill hiring, and TA transformation initiatives. Experience managing geographically dispersed TA teams and multi-location / multi-country hiring (if applicable). Hands-on exposure to ATS, HRIS, advanced sourcing tools (Linked In Recruiter, talent marketplaces, etc.) and TA analytics. Skills & Competencies Strategic Leadership & Business Acumen – ability to translate business strategy into long-term talent plans. Executive Stakeholder Management – strong presence and credibility with CXOs and senior leaders. People Leadership – proven ability to build, scale, and develop high-performing TA teams. Data-Driven Decision Making – comfort with metrics, dashboards, and predictive analytics. Change Management – ability to lead TA transformation, drive adoption of new tools and processes. Strong Communication & Negotiation – especially for leadership offers and complex stakeholder environments. Market & Industry Awareness – deep understanding of talent landscape, competitor moves, and compensation trends. High Integrity & Professionalism – strong ethical orientation, confidentiality, and judgment. Education Bachelor’s degree is mandatory (preferably in HR, Business, or related fields). Master’s degree in Human Resources / Business Administration (MBA/PGDM in HR) strongly preferred. Additional certifications in HR, Talent Strategy, or Organizational Development are an advantage. Success Measures / KPIs Achievement of annual and quarterly hiring plans (volume, seniority, and critical skills). Improvement in key TA metrics: time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, quality-of-hire, offer-to-join ratio. Leadership and critical role hiring success, including time-to-onboard and retention of senior hires. Employer branding impact: application quality/volume, social media engagement, campus outcomes. Diversity hiring outcomes and compliance adherence. TA team engagement, performance, and retention.
